headline: God of War facts you might not know
title: God of War Facts You Didn't Know | Kratos | Gaming Facts
video_script: Five God of War facts. One: the series was created by David Jaffe. Two: God of War twenty eighteen won Game of the Year at The Game Awards. Three: by November twenty twenty three the series had sold over sixty six million games. Four: Ragnarok came to PC on September nineteenth, twenty twenty four. Five: Bear McCreary composed the music for the Norse games and for Laufey. Which fact surprised you? Comment below!
description: God of War facts: created by David Jaffe, God of War (2018) won Game of the Year at The Game Awards, the series sold 66 million+ by November 2023, Ragnarok hit PC on September 19, 2024, and Bear McCreary scores the Norse games.
